title: LG Display passes 50 million large OLED panel sales, as OLED TVs help LG Electronics' TV business return to profit
content: LG Display announced that it has sold over 50 million large-area OLED panels for TVs and monitors, 13 years after it started selling OLED TV panels. It took LGD seven years to reach its first 10 million panels, in 2020, but sales have accelerated since then: the company passed 20 million in 2021, 30 million in 2023 and 40 million in 2025.

title: Nikon launches a new sub-micron FPD lithography system optimized for OLED production
content: Nikon Corporation announced that is has begun to accept orders for the FX-6ASLH, its FPD lithography system that achieves 0.85 µm (L/S) resolution, which is the world's first FPD lithography system to deliver submicron resolution.

title: LTOM reports increased revenues and profits for Q3 2026, raises $78 million to develop its Q-Cloth materials, targeting the AI datacenter market
content: China-based Shaanxi Lighte Optoelectronics Material (LTOM) reported its Q3 2026 financial results, with revenues of 176 million RMB ($26.4 million USD), an increase of 34.4% from last year. The company says that demand for OLED panels in China is recovering, and display makers have increased their material orders.

title: OLED Emitter Systems, Part 1: Fluorescence - The First Generation That Never Left
content: The OLED emitter is the material at the heart of every pixel, the organic molecule that actually turns electricity into light. Everything else in the stack exists to deliver charge to it. The emitter is a key part in determining the display's color, efficiency and lifetime.

title: Transformation in focus as display supply chain kicks off investor briefings
content: The panel display supply chain's transformation marathon continues as companies begin a week of investor briefings centered on new businesses. CoreIntelligence (CiHC), AUO, Radiant, BenQ Materials and E Ink will present in succession, with transformation progress remaining a key market focus.

title: CHPT posts record 3Q26 results as nine-month profit jumps over 90%
content: Chunghwa Precision Test Tech (CHPT), a major semiconductor test interface supplier, posted record revenue and profit in the third quarter of 2026 as consolidated net profit reached NT$551 million (US$16.97 million), up 11.5% quarter on quarter and double the figure from a year earlier. The company has earned more than one times its paid-in capital for three consecutive quarters, with earnings per share reaching NT$16.75.

title: AI startups face scrutiny over revenue metrics used to promote rapid growth
content: AI startups' revenue figures are under scrutiny as founders and investors question whether companies clearly distinguish active business from contracts that have not yet generated sales. The debate concerns how growth is presented to backers, employees and customers, and whether apparently comparable figures measure the same thing.
